title: Wayfare Pass Plan Multipliers in Wayfare Rides Fare Reviews
content:
**Member benefit schedule.** In a wrong drop-off review on **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)**, the member review multiplier follows the **Wayfare Pass (rider membership)** membership in force at the request — its plan and its status.

| Wayfare Pass membership in force at the request | Status | Member review multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Pass All Access Annual | trial, active or pending cancellation | 1.3 (All Access review multiplier) |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly or Wayfare Pass Plus Annual | trial, active or pending cancellation | 1.15 (Plus review multiplier) |
| Any other rider | — | leaves the figure as it is |

A Wayfare Pass All Access Annual membership in trial, active or pending cancellation status takes the All Access review multiplier of 1.3; a Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly or Plus Annual membership in one of those statuses takes the Plus review multiplier of 1.15; any other rider's figure is left as it is.

## Points of judgement

- "Any other rider" covers a rider with no membership in force at the request, a membership on any other Wayfare Pass plan, and an All Access or Plus membership that is paused, past due or in any status other than trial, active or pending cancellation.
- Example (hypothetical): a Wayfare Pass Plus Annual membership in pending cancellation status takes 1.15; a Wayfare Pass Plus Annual membership that is past due leaves the figure as it is.
- The membership is the one the trip records as in force at the request; its plan and status are read from that membership's record.
